entityName: Institute for Housing and Urban Development Studies (IHS)
entityDescription:
The Institute for Housing and Urban Development Studies, Rotterdam, the Netherlands 
Introduction 
The Institute for Housing and Urban Development Studies (IHS) is the international institute for urban management of Erasmus University Rotterdam working in developing and transitional countries. It offers specialized post graduate training, advisory services and applied research in the fields of urban management, housing and urban environment. IHS and its staff are committed to co-creating and sharing cutting-edge knowledge with urban professionals from across the globe to transform urban practice to make cities work. This work will also support the New Urban Agenda and contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals, which provides a frame of reference for all our projects. IHS was established in 1958, and joined the Erasmus University Rotterdam as an independent institute in 2004. This unique status allows the institute to draw on the extensive academic and institutional resources of the University whilst remaining dynamic, enabling effective innovation and quick responses to clients’ needs and changes in cities. Its mission is to develop the human and institutional capacities necessary to reduce poverty and improve the quality of life in cities worldwide. The institute works closely with local governments, international and local non-governmental organizations and the private sector worldwide, mainly in Asia, Latin America, Central and Eastern Europe, and Africa. Its mission is to develop human and institutional capacities and provide support to policy makers to reduce poverty and improve the quality of life in cities worldwide.

Mazzocchi Srl >>> Sheet metal working and mechanical construction since 1976
Mazzocchi has been operating in the mechanical sector since 1976, the objective is to satisfy the subcontracting needs of the precision mechanical industry.The main activity is the production of sheet metal parts for third parties, which is accompanied by a design and prototyping activity, the service is completed with the welding and assembly of the various assemblies.
The company choices based on the common thread of the continuous improvement of its quality and operational standards for the benefit and full satisfaction of all our Customers, allow us to maintain full competitiveness also in the aeronautical sector, offering milling services using pantograph, plasma cutting, waterjet cutting, laser cutting, bending, welding.

Mazzocchi Srl has been certified EN-UNI-ISO9001 for many years and has made compliance with the standard one of its strong points, in full vision of the needs of its customers.The company is qualified for various MIG/MAG, TIG, ELECTRODE, SUBMERGED ARC welding processes according to ASME_SEC_IX_2013

Mazzocchi Srl designs and builds non-destructive testing systems also in collaboration with leading companies in the sector.In particular, the activity focuses on the creation of: Penetrant liquid control systems - control cabins - washing cabins - bunkers for x-ray controls.

Novitek Solutions ApS is an R&D-performing SME, a commercial entity, system integrator, and supplier of remote management solutions. We also possess strong and innovative cross-disciplinary expertise in IT, applied statistics, mathematics, physics, and process automation, particularly in fog and edge cloud computing.

Our specialty lies in the development of applied ICT solutions that leverage novel methodologies for fog and edge cloud computing, integration platforms, IoT, data analytics, signal/image processing, informatics, mathematical and data modeling. We boast extensive knowledge and experience in agribusiness innovation projects and product development, including agribusiness e-commerce and automation.

We played a central role in the FP7 CLAFIS project, focusing on agricultural and forestry automation and connectivity challenges. Novitek has maintained a long-term commitment to improving interoperability and standardization of agricultural data and knowledge.

Furthermore, we deliver innovative and cost-effective IT systems and automation solutions in agribusiness and environmental applications, agro eCommerce, and on-demand last-mile logistics and transport applications. An integral part of our specialty involves the manufacture of GPS/Glonass/GSM tracking and fleet management systems. Our solutions and products are based on the EU-FP7 CLAFIS farm management system and the Eurostars-Eureka CALIS eCommerce and logistics system. Our technologies are also rooted in manufacturing automation and integration standards.

Novitek has extensive experience in coordinating large EU projects.

entityDescription:
AVL is the world’s largest independent company for the development, simulation and testing technology of passenger cars, trucks, and large engine powertrains (hybrid, combustion engines, transmission, electric drive, batteries, and software). Moreover, for more than ten years AVL has been supporting a variety of vehicle manufacturers in the series development of safe and reliable driver assistance functions (ADAS/AD) that exactly meet the complex requirements and high standards of OEMs in every phase of vehicle development. 

To this end, AVL Hungary, a cutting-edge research-development centre drawing on over a century of Hungarian automotive expertise and the innovation of the global AVL Group, has partnered with the modern and unique vehicle testing and development facility ZalaZONE. This new partnership, AVL ZalaZONE Proving Ground Ltd., has been in operation since November 1st, 2019. 

Specifically, our scope of activities includes the proving ground’s promotion, marketing, and business development, all in combination with products and services necessary for delivering the optimum test conditions and environment for your organization, whether you be an OEM, Tier 1, SME, or Engineering Services Provider. 

Our business directive is focusing on you, by combining the required infrastructure which is in-line with the needs of the global automotive market, together with our professional industry-specific management experience and significant developmental engineering competencies. These competencies involve generic module-based software and control environments to cover all levels of automation, allowing for flexible solutions regarding components and systems of different suppliers, with results ranging from feasibility studies and the development of progressive algorithms/simulations up to concept demonstrations in vehicles. 

AVL-ZalaZONE Proving Ground, your true partner for standard tests and the journey into the future of mobility.

entityDescription:
Neurobus is a new start-up that aims to bring neuromorphic perception and processing into space. It specializes in AI-powered data processing and spiking neural network training using neuromorphic processors for satellite communication on the edge. It contains all relevant experience between industry experience in space and defense, previous start-up experience, and deep knowledge and expertise in neuromorphic hardware and algorithms. In particular:

Florian Corgnou is a multi-time entrepreneur, having gained experience at the European headquarters of Tesla before co-founding Trezy, a fintech startup that has raised $4 million in funding and currently employs 12 people. He holds an MBA and MSc in International Business, as well as pursuing an MSc in Executive Innovation & Entrepreneurship fromHEC. In addition, Florian completed a 6-month Space Entrepreneurship program in partnership with Airbus DS.
Jerome Gilleron is a SUPAERO and Georgia Tech graduate, with an MS AE in 2016. He co-founded Space Eternity, an orbital data center, in 2018, and served as CEO until 2019. From 2019 to 2022, Jerome worked as an advanced system engineer at Airbus Defense and space. Currently, he is serving as the Deeptech startup accelerator program director at Starburst.
Dr. Gregor Lenz is a neuromorphic engineering Ph.D. graduate from Sorbonne University who specializes in event-based sensors and spiking neural networks. With a passion for developing open-source software for spike-based machine learning, he is currently working as a Neuromorphic Machine Learning Engineer at SynSense in Zurich, Switzerland.
Dr. Simeon Bamford is a highly experienced neuromorphic engineer with a proven track record of success in both academia and industry. With previous start-up experience at Inilabs AG and Inivation AG in Switzerland, Dr. Bamford has a deep understanding of the neuromorphic hardware, algorithms, and applications space. His expertise in the field has enabled him to design and develop cutting-edge technologies that mimic the functionality of biological systems, paving the way for new advances in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

entityDescription:
The Secretariat for Catholic Education supports over fifty Catholic Church schools in Malta and Gozo. Church schools cater for about one-third of the student population and provide education at kindergarten, primary, secondary and sixth-form levels.
The Secretariat falls under the jurisdiction of the Maltese Episcopal Conference. The Secretariat is also answerable to the Conference of Major Maltese Superiors and works closely with the Church Schools Association.
The main offices of the Secretariat are located very close to the Archbishop’s Curia in Floriana. The Secretariat has recently added more offices in Balzan.
The Secretariat serves as an important link to the Education Department at the Ministry for Education and Sports and the Malta Union of Teachers and other educational stakeholders.
The Secretariat provides provides administrative, curricular and psycho-social support to Church schools. The Secretariat administers the admission process into Church schools at Year 1 Kindergarten, Year 2 Kindergarten, Year 1 primary, Form 1/Year 7 secondary and when necessary at Year 4.
The Secretariat is also a member of the:
- OIEC (Catholic International Education Office)
- ECCE (European Committee for Catholic Education)
His Grace the Archbishop of Malta appoints a Delegate for Catholic Education who is responsible for the overall running of the Secretariat. Rev Dr Charles Mallia holds this office and is supported by Dr Ian Mifsud, as Director General. Directors and Assistant Directors sustain the work of the Delegate and Director by managing the various services provided by the Secretariat in schools:

The Secretariat employs over one hundred professionals ranging from administrative staff, psycho-social professionals and curricular specialists. These include:
- Head of departments of various subjects who support teachers and provide them with short courses.
- Administrative staff.
- Counsellors who visit schools to support students overcome their difficulties.
- Social Workers who help students and parents with the social requirements.
- Service managers for various services.
- Career Advisors.
- Youth Workers.
- Educational Psychologist who assess the educational requirements.
- Inclusive Educations Coordinators.
- Coordinators who are responsible for the inclusive education which involves in assessing children`s needs, as well as assisting children with special needs.
- Literacy Support Teachers who are responsible for the programmes such asLet me Learnand theMalta Writing Programme; Programmes targeted to improve teacher`s teaching abilities.

entityDescription:
More than 8,000 tons of space debris endanger all space activities. Satellite operators pay more than 14 million euro a year for evasive maneuvers and 1 billion USD in insurance premiums. Orbit Recycling is changing this. Space debris is transported from the orbit to the Moon and recycled there. More than 150 tons of aluminium can be regained from Ariane 5 upper stages alone. Large parts of the lunar station can be built with it, e.g., walls, power lines or heat storage systems. Since the debris is picked up in orbit, small propulsion units are sufficient for the transport to the moon, which are to launch cost-effectively with European rockets. This saves more than 50 billion euro in transportation costs.
Orbit Recycling is a Berlin based NewSpace organization which works with several universities and industry partners on proving the feasibility of this space debris recycling concept.

entityDescription:
Fields at Work GmbH was founded in April 2014 as a spin-off company of ETH Zurich. We are dedicated to provide expertise in engineering electromagnetics for applications in Health Research, Life Science and general engineering, i.e. monitoring of everyday electromagnetic fields and electromagnetics and optics for application in diagnosis and therapy. Our expertise is based on research and development carried out by the "Electromagnetics in Medicine and Biology Group" at the former Laboratory of Electromagnetic Fields and Microwave Electronics (now Institute of Electromagnetic Fields) of ETH. The first product arising out of our research collaborations was a first version of a portable radiofrequency exposure meter that was used within several European epidemiological studies on potential health effects of electromagnetic fields. Since then the devices of the ExpoM platform are gaining popularity worldwide and are used by Universities, Environmental Agencies and Industry.
The company has three activity branches, own product development and sales, contract development and research projects. The own products include two measurement device and components to integrate the measurement devices into an IoT platform. This also includes the entire backbone architecture. Examples of contract development can be found on our webpage. Currently we are involved in the EU project ETAIN (https://www.etainproject.eu/) where we provide experimental setups and a smartphone based data collection infrastructure together with our extensive expertise in exposure assessment and experimental studies on potential influences of RF-EMF on biological organsims and the environment.
